name: OpenTodo
description: Open-source, local-first task manager. Works offline and syncs every device from one small container.
longDescription:
OpenTodo is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) task manager you host yourself: one small container with the web app and a SQLite database. Projects, labels, due dates, reminders and sharing work in the browser and as an installable app that keeps working offline and syncs when your devices reconnect.

The first person to open it creates the owner account, using the setup token Cosmos shows after the install; after that the owner invites people.

Documentation: open-todo.app/docs/self-hosting
